commercialPolicy: Sky Market charges a 10% commission on verified ToB tool sales. Registration, connection, publication and base usage remain free; third-party API, model, payment and cloud costs are separate. Stripe Connect one-time JPY checkout, seller onboarding, order reconciliation and refunds are implemented but unconfigured; provider sandbox and live acceptance remain pending. The USD 8.88 ToC revenue fee proposal remains on hold and its 888-cent values are historical regression fixtures. Rock ATM fee remains zero per RQ15; game fees are unspecified.

requiresOwnerInputs: approved automation product and paying demand source
verified sales, payment and payout provider accounts
merchant and beneficiary identity, custody and payout policy
terms, privacy, tax, refund, chargeback and support disclosures

hardwarePolicy: Develop one shared RockstarOS Core with model-specific Device Support Packages. Physical native OS, experimental Android GSI, client-only and unsupported are distinct delivery modes. The first physical target is the owner-selected Japan-market Pixel 10 GL066 / frankel; this identity does not establish image, flash, boot or release readiness. BlackBerry requires exact-model unlock/vendor/recovery evidence; Apple mobile devices are client-only rather than OS-replacement targets. Linux QEMU and physical evidence remain distinct.
firstOperationalTarget: Fresh-host QEMU Developer Preview with reproducible install, launch, shutdown, reopen, backup and removal; synthetic data only

releaseInstallation.cmRule: Present the current implementation as the RockstarOS 1.0 base and advertise only the highest installation and validation stage that has passed its recorded gate

gameDeveloperExperience.multiOwnerReadiness: Authenticated multi-owner SDK/contract tests passed; actual OS UI acceptance remains one owner. Production player eligibility and real-value readiness remain unspecified; see docs/release-followup-20260910.md.
gameDeveloperExperience.osSubscriptionChange: none; ATM fee clarification does not change existing OS contract

marketExploration.scope: Rockstar Market is a generic typed-asset PAPER marketplace.
